metadata.name: Change a reminder
metadata.description: Use “Change a reminder” in Recued. Move a reminder still to ring to a new time, or change what it says. Take its id from My reminders. Pass a new time with its offset, and tell the user the time the answer gives.
metadata.author: recued-core

reminder_id.label: Reminder id
reminder_id.help: The reminder to change, as My reminders lists it (rem_…).

remind_at.label: New time
remind_at.help: The new time, as an absolute ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date-time WITH a timezone offset (e.g. 2026-07-04T15:00:00-07:00). Resolve the user's requested time against the current date/time in your context, in the user's timezone — do NOT assume UTC. Leave empty to keep the time.

reminder_text.label: New text
reminder_text.help: What the reminder says instead. Leave empty to keep it.
